messages:
Sara: Quick check — I'm assembling the internal release note + ops blast for tomorrow's deploy (18:00 PT). Draft is in this doc: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-22

Miguel: I skimmed it. Looks fine. Can we call out the DB migration window explicitly? Last time SRE missed the change window.

Priya: +1. Also need the exact pin for the model and the service artifact. Ops wants immutable pins to match rollback lanes.

Sara: Good catch. Proposed pins: service-api@v3.7.0, embed-model@2026-03-20-quant. Will update doc. Anyone object?

Janet: No objection. Add the rollback criteria: if error rate > 2% for 5m or latency p95 > 1.5s for 10m, rollback to service-api@v3.6.3 and embed-model@2026-03-10.

Mark: Also add canary gating: 5% traffic EU + 5% traffic US for 20 minutes, then ramp to 25% for 40 minutes if no regressions.

Priya: Can we put the exact deploy-bot commands in the notes so oncall can run them quickly? e.g.:

```
# pin release
deploy-bot pin service-api v3.7.0 --env prod --note "2026-03-22 release"
deploy-bot pin model embed-model 2026-03-20-quant --env prod
# start canary
deploy-bot rollout service-api --canary 5% --regions eu,us
```

Sara: Perfect. I'll paste that into the ops section. Also adding a short internal blurb for comms team — small snippet for #all-hands and for the internal digest. Draft below, please edit: 

```
Heads up: Tomorrow at 18:00 PT we'll roll out performance and accuracy improvements to embeddings and the public API (service-api v3.7.0). Expect a staged canary rollout with an enforced rollback policy. No action required unless you're on the oncall roster.
```

Miguel: Maybe call out expected customer-facing impact: slight improvement to multi-turn latencies and better reranking accuracy. Keep it concise.

Janet: One more ops detail — DB migration starts 18:05 PT (15m downtime for the index rebuild). Add that to the change window and update maintenance calendar.

Sara: Added everything. Two final asks: 1) someone run the deploy-bot pin in staging now to verify syntax, 2) signoff on internal blurb by 16:00 PT so comms can schedule the digest.

Priya: I'll run the staging pin in 10m and post the output here.

deploy-bot: [staging] pin service-api v3.7.0 -> OK (checksum abc123).

Priya: Staging pin succeeded. Syntax good.

Mark: Signoff from me on ops checklist. DB migration window OK.

Miguel: Signoff from product. Blurb tweak: change "No action required" to "No action required unless you own a customer-facing integration" — saves follow ups.

Sara: Updated blurb accordingly and queued the digest. Thank you all. I'll post the final internal note once comms schedules the blast. :tada:
